# Extension ledger

Proved extension: every requested finite derivative order `M`, subject to the
explicit time/order condition. This satisfies the standalone-paper gate.

Not proved:

- fixed-`t0` bounds uniform over all derivative orders;
- SU(N) or arbitrary compact groups;
- optimal constants;
- multidimensional affine-Weyl wall intersections;
- dependent interacting plaquette tails.

The natural higher-rank route is an affine-Weyl image atlas with separate
wall-intersection charts, but this is a new project rather than a corollary.
